thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Smart-routing policy triggered high error rate for 'customer-a-prod' (50% 5xx in last 2m). Auto-fallback engaged to region-us-west -> impacts tool-calling on some model variants. Please ack and investigate.

emily: acked, oncall here. Seeing a big spike in 503s to inference proxy for requests routed to us-west fallback. Who's on runtime?

raj: i can jump on runtime, on my way. initial quick look: routing policy sent requests to quantized-variant (q8_0) in us-west which does NOT have tool-calling enabled -> those requests are rejected by the toolchain layer with a 503.

sre_jordan: tagging logs. adding short timeline:
```
2026-03-15T02:02:03Z incoming request -> smart-router: prefer region-eu -> model fp16-tool -> OK
2026-03-15T02:03:12Z region-eu capacity throttled -> fallback rule -> route -> region-us-west -> model q8_0-no-tools
2026-03-15T02:03:12Z tool-proxy: tool-call requested but not supported -> 503 TOOL_UNSUPPORTED
2026-03-15T02:03:12Z client receives 503 -> retries -> loop attempts fallback again
```

alex: quick question — why is the fallback choosing q8_0-no-tools instead of q8_0-with-tools or fp16? config snapshot attached (snippet):
```
{"policy":"latency_first","fallback_order":["fp16-tool","q8_0-no-tools","q4_0"],"region_preference":["eu","us-west"]}
```

emily: ok that's the bug — fallback_order has q8_0-no-tools placed above any compatible tool-enabled variant for us-west. When eu is saturated, router picks the first available variant in the list regardless of feature flags.

maria-cs: customer impact: support ticket from customer-a says webhook tool calls failing intermittently for ~12m, 1200 requests failed, some timeouts on user-facing flows. They're in the PLG tier and this is causing visible UX errors. copying logs to the ticket.

ops-oncall: are we seeing any cascading region fallback loops? I see repeated route bounce: eu -> us-west -> eu for some traffic. that could be causing repeated attempts and double-counting errors.

raj: yes, router metric shows increased route-churn on that policy id. The router doesn't check 'tool_calling_supported' flag during fallback selection. I'll patch the selection filter to prefer variants with 'tool_calling:true' when request includes tool_call instructions.

emily: mitigation plan (short):
1) temporary manual change: modify fallback_order for the affected policy to move `fp16-tool` first and remove `q8_0-no-tools` (apply now).
2) disable auto-fallback to us-west for customer-a while we patch router logic.
3) rollback canary traffic to fp16-tool in eu for customers flagged PLG until fix.
4) alert CS + customers.

alex: i've applied the manual policy change (patch id: patch-1832-route) to staging -> plan to push to prod in 2mins. command used: `redwoodctl policies update --id=policy-17 --set 'fallback_order=["fp16-tool","q4_0"]'`

incident-bot: Change pushed by alex at 1832004690. Monitoring for 5m.

sre_jordan: after change, 503 rate dropped from 48% -> 3% in 60s. route-churn reduced. but we still have a class of in-flight retries that may have hit other regions.

maria-cs: CS update sent to customer-a: "We've applied a temporary routing change and are investigating root cause. Some calls may have been affected between 02:03-02:15 UTC. We'll follow up after full remediation."

raj: root cause notes for postmortem: router fallback selection considered only capacity and latency score, not capability flags (tool-calling, max_context). Also an edge case: q8_0 variant advertises context_length=2048 while request had 4096 -> router used it anyway because we had a lax context check. Need stricter compatibility matrix enforcement.

emily: quick triage checklist for eng-runtime:
- enforce capability intersection for candidate variants (tool_calling, max_context >= request).
- add unit tests for fallback ordering when request has tool_call field.
- add metric for fallback_compatibility_mismatch_count.

alex: putting a hotfix together now. small patch to router: when assembling fallback candidates, filter out variants where `supports_tools == false` if request includes a tool_call payload, and require `max_context >= request_context_len`. I'll push a canary to staging and then to prod.

ops-oncall: handoff note: i need someone to own monitoring and customer comms for next 4 hours. emily are you staying on?

emily: staying on for handoff to next oncall. i'll run a 30m watch and then handoff to ops-oncall (he will take next 2hr).

raj: hotfix pushed to prod at 1832004802 (hotfix-compat-filter). small change: `candidates = candidates.filter(v => v.supports_tools || !request.has_tool_call)`

incident-bot: Hotfix deployed by raj at 1832004802. Post-deploy health: error_rate 1.9% -> baseline 0.4% within 3m.

sre_jordan: capturing logs for postmortem. extracted sample failing request ids, routing decisions, and variant metadata. saving to /var/opt/incidents/1832004567/ for later analysis.

maria-cs: customer notified: follow-up message to customer-a with root cause summary and temporary remediation + SLA credit offer.

emily: handoff: i'm logging off in 30m. ops-oncall will be primary; raj will be on-call for runtime for 2 more hours for rollforward. please use the incident thread if you need anything.

ops-oncall: taking handoff. watching dashboards and alerts. leaving a short action list for postmortem:
- full compat matrix audit across all regions
- ensure variant metadata includes explicit `tool_calling` and `max_context` fields and that router enforces them
- add regression test in e2e for fallback scenarios (capacity drop + tool request)
- run a sweep for policies with ambiguous fallback orders

emily: adding timeline + actions to the incident tracker.

incident-bot: Incident resolved for customer-a at 1832004875. Severity: Sev3. Root cause: router fallback selection ignored variant capability flags leading to incompatible model variant selection during region fallback, causing tool-calling failures and region bounce loops.

emily: closing thread, will open postmortem doc with RCA and action owners. :white_check_mark:\"
